releases.name: Code Vein II: Mask of Idris
releases.summary:
In Mask of Idris, players are transported into a new, history-altering storyline where multiple timelines and worlds collide.

Forged from countless collapsed timelines, the Forsaken World is unlike anything players have seen before.

At its core lies a massive, swirling convergence of emotions, continuously pulling in fragments from across time and space. This phenomenon is no longer contained and now threatens to spill into the real world.

Exploration in this environment involves both danger and discovery, as players uncover the remnants of forgotten histories.

With new environments, characters, and a deeply immersive storyline, Mask of Idris expands the CODE VEIN II experience beyond its original boundaries.

Players will explore uncharted territories, confront powerful enemies, and unravel a narrative shaped by the collapse of multiple worlds.

releases.name: Touhou Koumakyou: New Classic - The Embodiment of Scarlet Devil
releases.summary: Dodge the barrage, defeat enemies, and brave the Scarlet Mist incident.The Embodiment of Scarlet Devil returns with fresh music and graphics.You control the shrine maiden Reimu and the magician Marisa, dodge barrages and shoot at enemies.The background music features complete rearrangements by ZUN.

releases.name: Detective VR
releases.summary:
DETECTIVE VR is a narrative investigation game for Meta Quest 3 & 3S: You can control time, collect clues and interview witnesses in Passthrough. The investigation takes place in your living room.

Explore unreliable testimonies and confront suspects to find out what happened!

A mix between ObraDinn/Immortality and Minority Report: An innovative way to tell a story in Mixed Reality.

releases.name: Valheim
releases.summary:
Valheim is a brutal exploration and survival game for 1-10 players set in a procedurally-generated world inspired by Norse mythology. Craft powerful weapons, construct longhouses, and slay mighty foes to prove yourself to Odin!

Explore a world shrouded in mystery. Discover distinct environments with unique enemies to battle, resources to gather and secrets to uncover! Be a viking, sail the open seas in search of lands unknown, and fight bloodthirsty monsters.

Raise viking longhouses and build bases that offer reprieve from the dangers ahead. Customise buildings, both inside and out, with a detailed building system. Progress through building tiers to upgrade, expand and defend your base.

releases.name: Barbarian Saga: The Beastmaster
releases.summary:
After the brief peace that followed the wars of the portals that devastated the country, new winds of war threaten its inhabitants when the new king of Imperia together with the Sacred Kingdom have started a war against non-humans, using the services of one of the Last Wizards of Arborea: Trece XIII and their generals, it is the moment of the prophecy, a chosen one will unite Men and beasts to bring peace.

A classic hand-drawn 2D Metroidvania action game. Use your Beastmaster skills to unleash your inner beast, fight with your heart-devouring sword and end the threat to Arborea.

releases.name: TORO 2
releases.summary: Reset is a card game in which you have to find groups of three cards, which are either all the same, or all different, in four categories: shape of the object, number of objects, fill pattern, and color. You get a full deck of 81 cards to play with!

releases.name: Picture Puzzle Girls - Slide & Match
releases.summary: Wild West Video Poker brings the fun of Vegas style 'Jacks or Better' video poker right to your fingertips. The app features actual Jacks or Better payout scale, upgrades, and unlock-able items. You can start earning daily interest, unlock higher stakes, and practice your way to a Video Poker Pro.

releases.name: Earth Must Die
releases.summary: Classic run and jump gameplay with a high speed twist!The force of the wind is a constant obstacle and tool as you solve puzzles on top of a bullet train! Moving against it is difficult, but moving with it grants you a burst of speed! Boxes, switches, and other objects form diabolical puzzles that require a sharp mind and quick reflexes.☆ 45 levels packed with puzzles, switches, boxes, and restarting because of complications due to boxes! With more on the way!☆ A mission for every level!  If you want even more of a challenge, each level has it's own mission that you can try to accomplish!  Some aren't too bad but others have been known to cause ragequits!☆ Responsive Touch Controls!  Touch screen platformer controls are never as good as a controller, but they come very close here! A simple 2 way D-Pad and jump button are all you have to deal with, ensuring that it's simple to hit what you're aiming for.☆ Support for ALL iOS devices!  From the 1st Gen iPod Touch to any iPad you want, you'll be able to play!  iPhone 5 resolution is supported too, so you won't have to stretch your thumbs past the black bars!☆ Time Attack mode!  How fast can you clear all the levels back-to-back?  See if you can get the best time on the leaderboard (aside from the inevitable hackers)!☆ Controller support!  Want to take it to the next level?  Bullet Train Hell features full support for iOS Game Controllers like the iControlPad, complete with remappable buttons so you don't end up having to press start to jump!

releases.name: Mewgenics
releases.summary:
From the creator of The Binding of Isaac, Super Meat Boy and The End is Nigh comes... Mewgenics! A game where you hoard, breed, train and set cats out on epic adventures through a sprawling world of complete chaos.

Level up your team as you venture further and further from your home, collect unique items, defeat epic bosses, gain mutations and return home so you you can breed and further your bloodline, in this turn based legacy roguelike draft sim about cats!

releases.name: Honeycomb: The World Beyond
releases.summary: Honeycomb: The World Beyond is a survival-sandbox game set on an exuberant planet – Sota7. Explore its vast world and face challenges on your bioengineering journey. Crossbreed plants or animals, gather resources, craft items, and conduct experiments in order to develop new species.

releases.name: Culdcept The First Saturn Tribute
releases.summary: Everygirl is dreaming for beautiful nail art and that makes every girl looks different from others and looks beautiful. This Girl Nail Art can let your dream comes true. A well-known Nail Art Game in the FASHION industry for you to express your style sense with Nail Art! and With this fun game, you can do the nail makeover, let your fingernail unique.The perfect Nail Art game for girls. Create exciting hot new looks and show off your sense of style and fashion with this awesome Nail Art up app.

releases.name: Surviving Mars: Relaunched - Feeding the Future
releases.summary:
Your colonists are hungry for more than survival. Provide your colonists with various delicacies and build local production to create the ultimate Martian diet in Surviving Mars: Relaunched — Feeding the Future.

After all, survival comes in many flavors!

releases.name: Aerial_Knight's MrFreezy
releases.summary: Quizconnect is the highly addictive new quiz game, that tests both your general knowledge and your puzzle-solving skills. Just guess the answer from the clue provided, and then spell it out on the puzzle grid. It is easy to play, and above all FUN! Choose from 4 different categories - Famous People, TV & Films, Characters and Lyrics. Quizconnect comes with with nearly 400 levels in total. Can you unlock them all?

releases.name: Bus Simulator 27
releases.summary:
Get ready for Bus Simulator 27, the most advanced entry in the history of the franchise. Look forward to our most comprehensive bus fleet yet - with new officially licensed brands and models, as well as iconic buses from the series.

Explore a vibrant new open world inspired by the Iberian Peninsula, featuring distinct districts, busy streets, and impressive landmarks - all brought to life with Unreal Engine 5.

Whether you're behind the wheel, walking the streets or riding as a passenger, the city is yours to discover. Plan custom routes and manage your growing business.

Play solo or team up with friends in 4-player co-operative mode.

releases.name: Halloween: The Game
releases.summary:
It’s Halloween night, 1978, the unsuspecting families of the quiet suburban town of Haddonfield are making holiday preparations, and evil has made its way home. Take The Shape of Evil as Michael Myers or save your neighbors as a Hero of Haddonfield in Halloween, the ultimate asymmetrical horror sandbox. 

As Michael, players wear the mask, become the Boogeyman, and stalk innocent residents with relentless obsession. Utilizing a nightmarish array of abilities, Michael leverages shadows and stealth to satisfy his bloodthirst. This doesn’t mean Haddonfield is going down without a fight. Frightened townsfolk will call the local authorities and even fight back when threatened, incentivizing Michael to avoid detection. And for the first time ever, fans of the transformative original film will have the option to witness the haunting narrative events surrounding "The Night He Came Home" through the eyes of Michael Myers in a standalone singleplayer story mode.

As a Hero of Haddonfield, it’s your job to alert the residents of Haddonfield to the impending evil and help them escape before falling victim to Michael’s unyielding pursuit. In dynamic and ever-changing 1v4 asymmetrical multiplayer matches, hero players must arm themselves with everyday household items, weapons, and knowledge to combat an unpredictable and unkillable enemy.

releases.name: SPRAWL zero
releases.summary: SPRAWL zero is a fast-paced shooter inspired by the Golden Age of 2000s FPS. Survive a brutal cyberpunk city collapsing under military rule and cult fanaticism. Use your Gravity-Gloves, augments, and an arsenal of over 40 weapons to crush those who stand in your way.

releases.name: Port of Jumanah
releases.summary: Pearl diving is an ancient tradition... until you showed up. Dive into the depths, poke things you probably shouldn't, battle sea monsters, recruit questionable allies, upgrade your gear, rebuild your port, and make increasingly questionable decisions in this roguelite action adventure.

releases.name: Kijutsu Rider
releases.summary: Prepare to become a Firearm Master! Firearm Master puts your tactical and marksmanship skills to the test with various firearm challenges including a Speed Range to test your quickness, Precision Range for precisely place shots, a Military Simulation Range to combine all of your firearm skills and a free shoot for firing at will. New range challenges and firearms will be included in every update monthly.- FREE firearm and range updates monthly!Firearm Master- Master firearms with First Person action.- Range challenges including a precision accuracy range, speed range free shoot and military simulation.- Realistic gun sway and firearm action.- New FREE firearms and ranges every month!- Zombie mode coming soon...Weapons- Assault Rifles including single-shot and automatic.- Scoped Long Rifles for precision shooting.- Several Handguns.- Unlock better firearms beating high scores in competition mode.- Update Coming Soon including new range modes and new firearms!

releases.name: Isle of Reveries
releases.summary: Make a pilgrimage skybound to the Isle of Reveries, where any wish can be granted. Conquer mysterious dungeons, solve puzzles, and explore a vast overworld in this retro-inspired adventure.

releases.name: Dream Cage
releases.summary:
Robert, 50 years old, has struggled with memory issues and insomnia for many years. Addicted to medication, he sometimes cannot distinguish reality from hallucinations. But the real question is - are they truly hallucinations? Or is there something else lurking beneath the surface?

Find over 25 anomalies to uncover the truth and the root of Robert's problems. Only by discovering them all will you unlock the true ending and reveal the full story. However, don’t be deceived by the apparent simplicity of the challenge. Robert’s mind hides many secrets, and these very mysteries will make your task all the more difficult.

releases.name: Tales of Formentera
releases.summary: Pit your football prediction skills against the other players to see who comes out on top of the league. Enter your predictions for each of the games before the cut-off time and see how well you know the beautiful game.Invite your friends and play against them to see who really knows the right score!

releases.name: Fear The Timeloop
releases.summary: Sheriff James Cooper is slowly bleeding to death in an unfamiliar hospital. But the moment his life ends, everything starts over. He has fifteen minutes to break this endless cycle, uncover the truth, and find a way out before it's too late.
